title: Identify the IDs and artists of cards that are legal in the Commander forma
question: Identify the IDs and artists of cards that are legal in the Commander format, have unknown power (either NULL or '*'), feature a 1997 frame style, and were illustrated by an artist whose name appears in rulings associated with cards that have content warnings.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_001", T1."XCL_002"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2
  ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND T1."XCL_019" = '1997'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT T3."XCL_002"
    FROM cards AS T3
    INNER JOIN rulings AS T4
      ON T3."XCL_072" = T4."XCL_090"
    WHERE T3."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL
  )
